config._purpose: EXPLORATORY, and the acceptance run of task T5. Parallel tempering of the capped model at the published size N = 160, every copy started from its own melted torus. Questions: are swap rates in a useful range, do graphs make round trips, does the cold end order (phi > 0.95) from a random start, and do the three hottest couplings, which are couplings of cqg_n160_capped_vs_t25fig3 where a single chain equilibrates, agree with that run. Coupling ladder tuned by eye on short scratch runs; not pre-registered.
config.name: cqg_n160_capped_tempering
